svg.text: Claude Code already reads and writes it. hyprlayer adds a view, a contained edit, and a reader for codex.
turnDone or exited in the workstream · worktreeChanged · window focus · the refresh button
the file changed on disk after editing began
the key comes from the repository root, so every worktree of a project shares one directory
at most 200 lines or 25,000 UTF-16 units, and the same file for every Claude tab of the project
write a topic file, add a line to the index
Claude decides what is worth keeping; topic files load on demand
only start opens a new thread; resume, restart and rewind send thread/resume
the index, bounded as Claude bounds it
withheld on a key mismatch, and when ~/.codex/config.toml sets developer_instructions, which a thread value would replace
the preamble names the directory, calls it read-only, and ranks the notes below the user and the repository
thread/resume carries it too, but codex 0.154.0 ignores it there: a resumed thread keeps the index it started with
read a topic file when it bears on the task
the sandbox keeps codex out of the directory except under Bypass permissions, where only the preamble does
opened from the lightbulb in the sidebar panel's header, and fetched only while it is open
the key check: the workstream's latest Claude session must have its transcript under project_key( cwd )
on a mismatch: no files, a Memory unavailable note, and a warn-toned ! badge
getDoc( path ) — the existing document reader
the one new write path; it overwrites an existing file and cannot leave the directory
a bare *.md name with no separator and no leading dot, naming an existing regular file, never a symlink
O_EXCL refuses a link planted at the temp name, so a save never writes through one
the webview invalidates the document and the listing
Reload from disk re-seeds the draft from disk, so one click cannot overwrite an agent's newer write
